{"type":"thought","data":" is roughly 67-69%, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"which aligns closely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with the market price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of 0.685."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nFair implied probabilities"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from typical bookmaker"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lines are roughly 18%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for Al Taawoun, 20%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for a draw, and 63%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for Al Qadsiah. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market price of 0.685"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is therefore slightly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" above the fair value."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nOther prediction models"}
{"type":"thought","data":" give Al Qadsiah a much"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lower win rate than"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the bookmakers. Wincomparator"}
{"type":"thought","data":" estimates 51.85%, while"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Oddspedia, Accaplanner,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and MyGameOdds all "}
{"type":"thought","data":"place the away team "}
{"type":"thought","data":"near 70%. These figures"}
{"type":"thought","data":" suggest the market "}
{"type":"thought","data":"price of 0.685 is slightly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" overpriced for Al Qadsiah"}
{"type":"thought","data":" winning."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nA true probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of 65% yields roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" -5.1% expected value"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at the current price."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The user's history "}
{"type":"thought","data":"shows fixed 100-token"}
{"type":"thought","data":" stakes with payouts"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tied to the odds, not"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a simple win-or-lose"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nWorking backwards "}
{"type":"thought","data":"from the user's historical"}
{"type":"thought","data":" payouts reveals the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" exact implied prices"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for each past bet. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"The 56.2 token profit"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on Utah corresponds"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to a 0.640 price, while"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the 132.6 token profit"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on Amazon corresponds"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to 0.430. This confirms"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the payout formula "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is 100 times (1 minus"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price) divided by price."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe payout math confirms"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the No side is far "}
{"type":"thought","data":"more profitable than"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Yes. At 0.315, a win"}
{"type":"thought","data":" yields roughly 217 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"tokens versus about "}
{"type":"thought","data":"46 for Yes at 0.685."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nExpected value calculations"}
{"type":"thought","data":" show No carries a positive"}
{"type":"thought","data":" edge even if Al Qadsiah's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" true win probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is only 65%. At that"}
{"type":"thought","data":" level, No offers about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" +11 expected profit"}
{"type":"thought","data":" while Yes loses roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" -5. The gap narrows"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to about +4.8 when "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the true probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rises to 67%, but No"}
{"type":"thought","data":" remains the clear choice."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nAt a true win probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of 63%, the No side"}
{"type":"thought","data":" yields roughly +17.5"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected profit while"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Yes loses about -8.0."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.685 sits close to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the raw bookmaker implied"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rate, but the fair "}
{"type":"thought","data":"probability after removing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" overround is closer"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to 63-66%. Models disagree"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on whether Al Qadsiah"}
{"type":"thought","data":" should be closer to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 69% or 70%."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe phrase \"most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off\" is ambiguous."}
{"type":"thought","data":" It could mean highest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected value, or "}
{"type":"thought","data":"simply the most probable"}
{"type":"thought","data":" outcome. The user's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" prior record shows "}
{"type":"thought","data":"fixed 100-token stakes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with payouts tied to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" odds, so the competition likely rewards profit"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and loss rather than"}
{"type":"thought","data":" pure correctness. I"}
{"type":"thought","data":" need to clarify the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" exact scoring mechanism"}
{"type":"thought","data":" before choosing an "}
{"type":"thought","data":"outcome."}
